def factor_vol_adaptive_reversal_smooth_weight(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    close = df_copy["close"]
    ret5 = close / close.shift(5) - 1.0
    ret20 = close / close.shift(20) - 1.0
    power = 1.5
    rev_short = -np.sign(ret5) * np.abs(ret5) ** power
    rev_long = -np.sign(ret20) * np.abs(ret20) ** power
    ret = close.pct_change()
    short_vol = ret.rolling(20, min_periods=5).std()
    long_vol = ret.rolling(100, min_periods=20).std()
    weight = short_vol / (short_vol + long_vol).replace(0, np.nan)
    weight = weight.fillna(0.5)
    signal = weight * rev_short + (1.0 - weight) * rev_long
    df_copy["factor_vol_adaptive_reversal_smooth_weight"] = signal.fillna(0.0)
    return df_copy["factor_vol_adaptive_reversal_smooth_weight"]
